title: Why Your Body Jumps Just as You Fall Asleep 😴 #shorts
description:
Did it happen to you this week? Yes or no?
That sudden falling jolt is called a hypnic jerk. Up to 70% of people get them, and scientists still aren't sure why.

Sources: Sleep Foundation (hypnic jerks), McGill Office for Science and Society, Live Science
